item.title: [+1] India, Egypt To Work On Terms Of Reference For Potential Trade Pact
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 28 reports from Firstpost, DD News, The Times of India and 21 more. Related: “India-US trade deal: A 21-month timeline of negotiations and where things stand now”. Ongoing: also reported on 4 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Farm exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Rising food prices push India's inflation above RBI comfort zone
item.description:
Signal: rising Indian food prices (India). 2 reports from NewsBytes, Borneo Bulletin. Related: “Rising food prices push India’s inflation to two-year high”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Better farm-gate prices

Why it matters: Food carries a large weight in India's CPI, so rising food prices squeeze household budgets and limit the RBI's room to cut rates.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −2, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
